title: Artisan Variable
description: A Variable is a named, typed value that chains write (`set_var`, `add_var`, `clear_var`) and that conditions and texts read as `{var.<id>}`. File `variables/<id>.yml`; the id is the file name.

scope.description: `player`: one value per player, follows them across the network. `server`: one value shared by every player of the network.

type.description: What the value is. A write of another type is refused; a stored value that no longer matches (the type changed) is read as absent.

default.description: What `{var.<id>}` reads while nothing is stored. `has_var` stays false: the default is not a stored value.

expires_seconds.description: Lifetime of a value after its last write; 0 or absent: it never expires.

notes.description: The author's notes, never read by the server.
